description: Search Yelp businesses by name, category, or location. Accepts a query and location. Returns Yelp's own ranked results with rating, review count, price, phone, categories, address and coordinates; sort by recommended, highest_rated or most_reviewed; 10 per page, up to 24 pages. Pass an alias to yelp_business_get or yelp_reviews_list. Credits: 1 (0 when no businesses).
